entities.summary: Werner Delmes was a German field hockey player who competed in the 1956 Summer Olympics and 1960 Summer Olympics. He was born in Cologne, Rhineland, Prussia, Germany. Delmes died in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia, on 13 January 2022, at the age of 91.
